name: Journalism, Public Relations and Communication
description: ⚠⚠⚠ One family, and the two ends are moving in opposite directions. Journalism is 292 bachelor's a year at 5 Florida institutions into an occupation BLS projects to DECLINE 6%. Public relations, advertising and general communication together produce roughly 2,350 a year into occupations that are growing. ⚠⚠ Same writing, same degree family, very different markets.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠ THE SIZE DIFFERENCE IS THE FIRST THING TO SEE. Journalism (09.0401) is 5 Florida public institutions and 292 credentials, every one a bachelor's — UF 176, UCF 55, FAMU 54. ⚠ Against that: Communication General (09.0101) 6 institutions and 1,111 credentials with 1,071 bachelor's; the public relations and advertising family (09.09) 1,241 across its three codes — Public Relations and Applied Communication 601, Advertising 341, Public Relations/Image Management 299. ⚠⚠ Roughly 2,350 communication credentials against 292 journalism ones, and the occupational data points the same way: 314,500 public relations specialists with 23,000 annual openings against 47,100 journalists with 3,400. ⚠⚠⚠ THAT IS NOT AN ARGUMENT AGAINST STUDYING JOURNALISM — the reporting and verification training is the best writing education in this family and it travels — but it is an argument for knowing where the jobs are before choosing the major. ⚠ NUMBERING TO WATCH: Basic Reporting is JOU1100 at 7 institutions, ALL state colleges, while Journalistic Writing and Reporting is JOU2100 at 8 (3 state colleges, 5 universities), with NO overlap. Media Planning is ADV3300 at 4 universities and ADV4300 at 4 others, again with no overlap. ⚠ All are lower or upper division consistently within each pair, so no baccalaureate credit is at risk — the cost is transfer matching. Send syllabi.

cips.note: ⚠ Journalism — only 5 Florida public institutions and 292 credentials, every one a bachelor's. University of Florida 176, UCF 55, FAMU 54, UF-Online 7. The smallest degree in the family and the one whose occupation BLS projects to decline 6%.

⚠⚠ Communication, General — 6 Florida public institutions and 1,111 credentials, 1,071 of them bachelor's. UCF 307, FIU 258, USF 213, FAU 171, FGCU 142. The largest single code in the family by a wide margin, and the one most graduates in these occupations actually hold.
Public Relations, Advertising and Applied Communication, General — 6 Florida public institutions and 601 credentials. The combined route, and the commonest home for a PR concentration.
Advertising — 4 Florida public institutions and 341 credentials. Narrower than the combined code but a substantial programme where it exists.

Public Relations/Image Management — 6 Florida public institutions and 299 credentials: 242 bachelor's, 27 short certificates, 17 associate, 13 very short certificates. University of Florida 195 plus 36 online, Valencia 30, FAMU 24.

related.note: ⚠⚠⚠ The comparison that matters most on money. Marketing managers reach a $166,790 median against public relations specialists' $74,750, and Census microdata puts COMMUNICATIONS second among the undergraduate fields marketing managers hold, at 88,800 people. ⚠ A communication degree reaches the marketing ladder; it is one of the better-paid exits from this family and almost nobody points at it.

⚠⚠ A genuine overlap rather than a neighbour: Digital Communication and Media (09.0702) is 29 Florida institutions and 797 credentials, filed in the communication family but doing design work. ⚠ If the visual side of communication is the draw, that is where it lives.

⚠ A destination for communication graduates that is growing rather than shrinking: training and development specialists number 452,300 with 43,900 annual openings against journalism's 3,400. ⚠⚠ The field screens on a portfolio and values exactly the explanatory writing journalism teaches.

⚠ Named because corporate communication, internal communication and investor relations are business functions, and a communication degree with business coursework reaches them. ⚠⚠ It is also the portable option if the media industry's contraction continues.

⚠ Named for a specific and underadvertised route: health communication is a named content area in the CHES credential, county health departments employ communication specialists, and the CHES route is coursework-based rather than major-based.
